coverage.clubs: Complete here means, under the 24/11 12:35 scope, a ranking of the 3 to 5 most important groups per country of the perimeter (FR DE GB US BE NL CH AT IT AU ES CA DK PL LU NZ CZ SE PT ZA NO IE FI CN SK MC) plus notable online and alternative-brand clubs, not an exhaustive census. Reference lists read on 2026-11-24: Avenue de la brique associations https://www.avenuedelabrique.com/associations-lego (84 FR/BE/CH/LU entries, each page opened) and agenda https://www.avenuedelabrique.com/expositions-lego; Deparkatre https://deparkatre.fr/associations (recognition badges); steine-kanal.de German associations 2024-03-22 https://www.steine-kanal.de/lego-vereine-in-deutschland-vorgestellt/; Bricks McGee UK list https://www.bricksmcgee.com/lego-user-groups-lugs-in-the-uk/; Canuck Bricks https://www.canuckbricks.ca/clubs; BlockBlaze South Africa https://blockblaze.co.za/south-african-lego-community/; brickmaniacos.com Spanish associations 2026-11-20; Brikkelauget local clubs https://brikkelauget.no/lokale_foreninger/; swiss-brick.com events 2026-11-02; Fan CoLab pages of single communities as official evidence. Uncertain: sizes are rarely published, so ranks are made on the criterion named per country and several ranks 4-5 rest on age and dated activity; not covered by a search of their own: Slovakia (served by Kostky.org), Monaco (nothing found), Denmark, Sweden, Finland (only one documented group each beyond filed ones), Portugal (two groups), Romania, Bulgaria and other Fan CoLab countries outside the perimeter; Reddit and Discord clubs and train or Technic clubs were searched only through the lists above (no new train or Technic club entered a top five). Recognition by LEGO was not cross-checked against Fan CoLab for every candidate: the project lead should do it.

confidence_overall: medium: ranks for FR, DE, GB, US, AU, NZ, CH, IE, PL, ES rest on declared figures or dated events read on 2026-11-24; ranks in CA, ZA, IT, CN, SK and the Nordics rest on age and recognition because sizes are not published; 11 candidates have no dated activity on their own page
recommendation: Add the 30 candidates with confidence high or medium (2 are low: BrianzaLUG, LUG South) after a quick check of the dates marked null (GertLUG, LELUG, LuxLUG, DFW LUG, MUGs, Southern Bricks, NALUG, ParLUGment, HamLUG, CapeLUG, BrianzaLUG) in a real browser, and cross-check each against the Fan CoLab list (a recognised group is still wanted if it is top of its country). One more push is useful only for Denmark, Sweden, Finland, Portugal, Slovakia, Romania and China (Exa and a Chinese-language search tool); the rest is covered. Candidate AFOL Festival (afolfest.cn) and Svět kostek, Brick Féile, Bricktopia belong to the events lot.
